perItemFindings.label: S5
perItemFindings.one_line: `condAbsMoment_eq` holds only X-marginal-a.e., but clause (v) and t7 use the conditional-kernel moment at every support point; no continuity or pointwise kernel/version field bridges that gap.

perItemFindings.label: lem:cty-winsorization-bias
perItemFindings.one_line: Its planned proof applies the pointwise envelope to `condDistrib ... x`, although S5 identifies `condAbsMoment` with that integral only a.e.; the asserted every-x conclusion is not supported.

perItemFindings.label: lem:cty-support-boundary-angular-packing
perItemFindings.one_line: Its reuse notes still direct `Causalean.Stat.Nonparametric.HolderBallStd` to establish the packing laws' class membership, but that predicate is on sup-normed `Fin d → ℝ`; the class now requires local EuclideanHolderBallStd and no bridge is recorded.

verbatim_critique: Re-plan S5/t7 to carry a selected conditional kernel (or an equivalent pointwise conditional-moment version) whose moment envelope is pointwise on support, then state t7 against that selected version; a.e. equality alone cannot justify the every-x kernel claim. Re-plan t2 to discharge the local EuclideanHolderBallStd predicate directly (or record and prove a norm-constant bridge); do not cite HolderBallStd as an exact reuse.
